summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn and its home, extending through farms, Mirror Tarn, Garden and Market districts, a royal city/castle and a hilltop village. Authored scenes combine terrain-driven procedural structures, activity systems, crowds and wildlife; the player uses WoW-style movement, bending combat, and Wynx the rideable/following gryphon. A player whose identity is wunix is specially rendered and animated as a red fox instead of using the regular avatar/mount presentation.
places: places/main/config.yaml - one seeded forest terrain, water/marks/material bands and fog/look settings for the world
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn, The First Den/home, farms and many authored activities/landmarks
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake/creek approaches and wolf-pack combat encounters
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - Ember Roost, folk and town-square crowd roots
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene - hilltop village and its village-crowd root
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - Garden Market crowd and district activities
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared or separately authored placed objects across the main place
roots: templates/player.js#player - player entity behavior stack: movement, locomotion, home/travel/activity, gryphon mount, bending and fox-companion special handling
templates/camera.js#camera - custom WoW camera root; computes body heading/orbit and riding-aware third-person presentation
places/main/config.yaml - main place terrain, material, water, fog and environment root
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#sky-dragons - scheduled sky-dragon flight manager root
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#wolf-pack - local wolf encounter manager and den population
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#folk-crowd / #town-crowd - district and square population managers
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene#village-crowd and places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene#garden-crowd - village and Garden Market population managers
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract used by terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/lib/wow-steer.js - camera-relative WoW steering shared by player and camera/locomotion behavior
scripts/lib/data/gryphon.js + scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - Wynx movement/flight tuning, animation/audio modes and FX shared by mount and follower behavior
scripts/lib/data/npc-models.yml - model and rig-height registry reused by folk, town, garden and village crowd managers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - shared solid/collider construction for road and site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/bending.js + scripts/lib/fct.js - bending/combat rules and combat-text event helper used by bender, wolf-pack and HUD
scripts/lib/town-kit.js + scripts/lib/data/town-links.json - civic builder helpers and named route/sign layout shared across town districts
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); handles identity presentation, movement and gryphon ground-riding clearance
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - ride(), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gryphon-mount.js - onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/wynx.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - FEATHERS, DUST, setMode, yawOf
scripts/fox-companion.js - onSpawn(ctx), update(ctx,dt); applies the wunix fox model, movement-facing, ambient animation and effects
scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - crowd update managers; scripts/sky-dragons.js - onSpawn, launch, roar, ears, update
scripts/bender.js - zap, maxHp, land, aoe, release, onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/wolf-pack.js - updateSchedule, aggroRadius, update
scripts/ui.js - onMount(), onDestroy(), default(ctx,player); scripts/bend-hud.js - fctPush, fctLayer, bendHud
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; flyBoost scales flight speed; movement scratch/cached intent remain in ctx.session
scripts/camera.js - camera.state.heading is body WoW heading and camera.state.off is separate orbit/look offset; publishes native orbit and collision distances

scripts/gryphon-mount.js + scripts/wynx.js - mount behavior owns player riding/flyBoost transitions; Wynx owns her unmounted follow position, yaw and animation mode; per-player mount scratch is in ctx.session.gry
scripts/fox-companion.js - for the wunix player only, sets fox appearance and owns animation/facing/effect selection; fox timing scratch is in ctx.session.foxState
scripts/bender.js + scripts/lib/data/bending.js - player bending level/XP, HP/chi, stance/spells, cooldowns, target, combat and cast/channel state; tick scratch is in ctx.session
scripts/wolf-pack.js - wild-wolf HP, level, threat, target, status, death/respawn and combat; publishes changed summaries to place.state.wolves
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - each manager owns its roster's NPC spawn/route/pose and scheduling; per-manager scratch remains in ctx.session
scripts/sky-dragons.js - manager state owns scheduled flight requests/live dragon IDs and flight poses; dragon entities carry their path/time state
flows: templates/player.js behavior stack -> player.js input/update -> player movement/flying state; humanoid-locomotion reads casting/riding and provides the corresponding animation pose
player Z/mount action -> gryphon-mount.js finds or spawns the tagged Wynx, seats/dismounts rider and updates riding/flyBoost; scripts/wynx.js follows the owner when unmounted
player movement/flying + player.state.riding='gryphon' -> player.js ground saddle-height raycast/terrain clearance and hop; camera.js detects riding for third-person orbit
gryphon-mount.js / wynx.js mode changes -> lib/wynx-kit.js setMode -> anim/gryphon.yml clips, spatial audio and speed FX; scripts/lib/data/gryphon.js supplies mount/follow tuning
templates/player.js -> fox-companion.js; player.js detects wunix and switches their entity to scripts/gen/animal-fox.js while fox-companion drives fox animation/facing and airborne effects
player inputs -> scripts/bender.js -> player bending/cast state and scheduled release/land/aoe handlers -> wild-wolf effects/damage
bender damage/status/threat writes -> scripts/wolf-pack.js scheduled update -> combat, death/respawn and player rewards; summaries flow through place.state.wolves to bend-hud via ui.js
scripts/lib/fct.js fct() -> uiEvent named fct -> scripts/ui.js onMount -> bend-hud text pool renders hit/heal/XP feedback
places/main/config.yaml marks/seed -> forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt -> terrain, water and material bands; site marks coordinate terrain clearing/grading with scene structures
folk/town/garden/village crowd roots -> manager scripts read their roster YAML and npc-models.yml -> spawned NPC model/rig or procedural actor, movement and pose
x0z0.scene sky-dragons root -> sky-dragons scheduled launch/live-ID update -> moving sky-dragon entities; `sky-dragons:launch` ears requests additional launches
farm windmill state.sails/degPerSec -> farm-windmill.js rotates sail child; alchemy/fishing/garden/boat handlers keep their separate activity state
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest flora varies by layer, kind and terrain; main terrain now uses painted low-poly texture bands and height fog
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + cob-furnish.js - multilevel tree-centered home/furnishing varies by item, dimensions, palette and seed
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js; town-lane.js + town-rampart.js - bridge and town-road/boundary geometry vary by dimensions, route, gaps and seed
scripts/gen/town-square.js + town-kit/town-link.js - civic pieces, lamps, directional posts and named links vary by kind, layout and placed text
scripts/gen/farm-crops.js, farm-fence.js, farm-props.js - crop rows, orchard props, pens, barns/mill and scarecrows vary by crop, points, style, item and seed

scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js + npc-models.yml - rosters share model-backed player-style NPC bodies and poses with procedural fallback and per-district routes/wardrobe
scripts/gen/dire-wolf.js + wolf-den.js + wolf-pack.js + anim/wildwolf.yml - den-based animated combat wolves vary by coat, level, elite/boss state and den rules

scripts/gryphon-mount.js + scripts/wynx.js + scripts/gen/gryphon.js + anim/gryphon.yml - Wynx is summoned/ridden, then follows on foot or in flight; movement and animation modes vary by rider state, distance and speed
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
scripts/gen/garden-garb.js and scripts/gen/garden-wear.js - earlier map found no current scene/template references
scripts/gen/royal-cathedral.js and scripts/gen/royal-statue.js - earlier map found no current scene attachments
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing near (0,-3); keep material IDs, terrain marks and decoration bindings coordinated.
Gryphon origin is the rider's feet; GRY.paws sets saddle/ground clearance. player.js raycast + terrain height, GRY.paws, mount geometry and unmounted Wynx ground-follow behavior are coupled.
Wynx's mount lifecycle is keyed by player.state.riding='gryphon' and tagged `wynx` entity ownership; keep mount state, companion owner/ridden flags, camera detection and locomotion ride pose aligned.

npc-models.yml supplies model heights for roster NPCs, with procedural folk/villager fallback; model-backed poses use humanoid-locomotion, so retain the height/layout and animation-channel assumptions across crowd managers.
Sky dragons are tracked by manager state.live IDs rather than a world-wide query; flight posing samples terrain once per pose into GROUND, not once per sampled point.
Mirror Tarn is centered (82,78), water level 0.3 with depth 2.6; shore and Three Squares links in main config, town-links.json and scene signs describe the same routes.
